## Observation
Dependabot Updates run 41918750684 tried `uv lock --upgrade-package pydantic-ai-slim==2.64.0` for 3 extras ([openai], [bedrock], [anthropic,duckduckgo,retries]) and each failed with dependency_file_not_resolvable: 'nava-rebar[agents] depends on pydantic-ai-slim[anthropic]>=1.107,<2 and pydantic-ai-slim==2.64.0 ... unsatisfiable'. .github/dependabot.yml ignores semver-major only for mcp, so every weekly uv run retries this major bump and reports it as an error.
## Testing

Checked: the Dependabot uv run triggered by the dependabot.yml change (`gh run view <id> --log`) shows the pydantic-ai-slim ignore condition in the job, no `uv lock --upgrade-package pydantic-ai-slim==2.*` attempt, and no dependency_file_not_resolvable for pydantic-ai-slim.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Decide between adopting pydantic-ai-slim 2.x and ignoring its semver-major updates in .github/dependabot.yml, with the reason recorded.
- [x] [non-codebase] The next Dependabot uv run records no dependency_file_not_resolvable error for pydantic-ai-slim.
